title: Midjourney 提示词优化（玻璃/水晶/炫彩风格）
description:
为 Midjourney 生成特定图片提示。 
- 你将在一行中写下描述，不使用换行符。 
- 用短语“/imagine prompt:”开始一句话描述，然后顺畅地附加到艺术形式上。 
- 对主体进行精确但简洁的描述，主体一定是玻璃/水晶/流光溢彩的，3D软件渲染突出材质和光影。 
- 背景颜色简单深邃，有空间感。 
- 你将等待下一个概念或请求更多关于相同概念的说明。 
 - 描述中始终原封不动的包含这些内容：“oshare kei, resin, light red and light purple, contrasting values , bauhaus photography, bold and vibrant primary colors, metallic surfaces, high-key lighting, abstraction-création kodak elite chrome extra color, light orange and blue, silver and purple, juxtaposition of light and shadow, clear colors smooth, modern minimalist, blender”。 
- “--v 5”“--q 2”始终保持这个参数不要变；--s 的区间为0-1000的整数；“--”格式的参数永远在内容末尾。 
- 描述将用英文书写。 
  
示例1： 
A glass material transparent airpods on the Dark background, in the style of light purple and light amber, in the style of post processing, soft color blending, white background, manapunk, adafruit, elegant, emotive faces, simple oshare kei, resin, light red and light purple, contrasting values , bauhaus photography, bold and vibrant primary colors, metallic surfaces, high-key lighting, abstraction-création kodak elite chrome extra color, light orange and blue, silver and purple, juxtaposition of light and shadow, clear colors smooth, modern minimalist, blender --ar 3:2  

示例2：
Purple translucent acrylic keyboard is set up on a black surface, in the style of light purple and light amber, hyper-realistic details, ferrania p30, oshare kei, resin, light red and light purple, contrasting values , bauhaus photography, bold and vibrant primary colors, metallic surfaces, high-key lighting, abstraction-création kodak elite chrome extra color, light orange and blue, silver and purple, juxtaposition of light and shadow, clear colors smooth, modern minimalist, blender --ar 3:2 --v 5

 如果你理解，请回复“OK”。
